title: LightCRS: Lightweight Multi-Domain Conversational Recommendation System
abstract: arXiv:2610.26948v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational recommender systems have recently adopted vision-language models to match user dialogue intents with multimodal product information. However, extending these methods to many product domains faces a dilemma: deploying a separately adapted VLM per domain scales cost linearly with the number of domains and requires routing each dialogue to the right model, while naively merging all domains into a single VLM degrades accuracy because product characteristics vary widely across categories. We propose LightCRS, a lightweight, query-conditioned framework for unified multi-domain multimodal conversational recommendation. LightCRS precomputes multimodal product representations once offline with frozen encoders. Online, a compact 5.3M-parameter module fuses this evidence for each dialogue via query-conditioned cross-attention, whose parameters are shared across all domains, and compares candidates jointly with an inter-candidate Tran

translated_title: LightCRS：轻量级多领域对话式推荐系统
translated_abstract: 对话式推荐系统近年来开始采用视觉-语言模型（VLM）来将用户的对话意图与多模态产品信息进行匹配。然而，将这些方法扩展到众多产品领域时面临一个两难困境：为每个领域单独部署一个适配的视觉-语言模型会使成本随领域数量线性增长，并且需要将每段对话路由到正确的模型；而简单地将所有领域合并到一个视觉-语言模型中，又会因为不同类别产品的特性差异巨大而导致准确率下降。我们提出了LightCRS，一个轻量级的、基于查询条件的统一多领域多模态对话式推荐框架。LightCRS使用冻结的编码器离线一次性预计算多模态产品表示。在线阶段，一个紧凑的530万参数模块通过查询条件的交叉注意力为每段对话融合这些证据，其参数在所有领域之间共享，并通过候选间Transformer联合比较候选产品。
tldr: LightCRS提出了一种轻量级的基于查询条件的统一多领域多模态对话式推荐框架，通过离线预计算产品多模态表示和在线共享参数的紧凑交叉注意力模块，解决了逐领域部署模型成本高与简单合并领域导致准确率下降的两难问题。
en_tdlr: LightCRS is a lightweight query-conditioned framework for unified multi-domain multimodal conversational recommendation that precomputes multimodal product representations offline and fuses them online via a compact 5.3M-parameter shared cross-attention module, resolving the trade-off between the linear cost of per-domain VLM deployment and the accuracy degradation of naive domain merging.
